policy: This audit classifies existing release gates; it does not open any gate or alter forecast inputs.

nonCertifyingCycles.reason: v1 implementation defect; v2 post-hoc diagnostic

criticalSourceFreshness.reason: The model-eligible poll registry is stale against the fixed 21-day policy; the 2026-09-15 RedBridge/Accent wave is staged but not model-eligible.
criticalSourceFreshness.nextDecision: Complete explicit evidence and model-eligibility review; do not auto-promote.

modelInputFreshness.reason: One newer staged record remains unresolved; evidence acceptance and model eligibility are separate decisions.
modelInputFreshness.nextDecision: Project owner/model owner resolves the staged September RedBridge/Accent decision.

completeForecastBacktest.reason: Only three certifying v2 cycles exist; 2018 was consumed with an implementation defect and cannot be made fresh again.
completeForecastBacktest.nextDecision: Keep closed; define a new prospective protocol/model version if further validation is desired.

probabilityCalibration.reason: The required four-cycle clustered calibration evidence is incomplete; final-pair and regional-primary probability products are also unavailable.
probabilityCalibration.nextDecision: Keep closed; do not infer calibration from partial cycles.

productionAuthorisation.reason: Upstream freshness, complete-backtest and calibration gates are not all passed; production compatibility remains false.

septemberRedbridgeAccent.methodology: online panel with quotas and rim weighting; undecided leaners; unresolved respondents excluded
septemberRedbridgeAccent.timingRegime: Carroll-Wilson regime retained as a required review check

nextAction: Obtain the explicit project-owner/model-eligibility decision for the staged September RedBridge/Accent evidence. If admitted under the existing policy, refresh current poll inputs in a separate reviewed batch; otherwise retain the last valid forecast. Do not alter historical v2 or production authorisation.
